mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when unemployment exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI with low FEDFUNDS indicates inflationary pressures met with easy money, boosting stocks.
failure_condition: No positive returns despite high CPI and low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth in late-cycle expansion signals economic slowdown, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns despite slowing GDP in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing employment suggests a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite employment growth.

mechanism_narrative: Declining real personal consumption indicates weaker demand, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when RSAFS is below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production with slowing GDP indicates supply outweighing demand, leading to negative returns.
Rising federal funds rate in tightening cycle increases borrowing costs, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in tightening cycle.
